items.name: Vault poles
items.description: d20 1–5. Advantage on checks to board adjacent junks.

items.name: Safety harnesses
items.description: d20 6–10. Resistance to bludgeoning from Out-of-Control or Massive Damage effects.

items.name: Rear-view mirrors
items.description: d20 11–15. +1 AC and saves against effects from behind.

items.name: Dashboard saint
items.description: d20 16. Once per race, the driver can reroll a handling check.

items.name: Infrared windshield
items.description: d20 17. Driver gains darkvision and advantage on handling checks triggered by smokescreens.

items.name: Auto-pilot
items.description: d20 18. Animated armor with +4 to handling checks.

items.name: Necro-piloting system
items.description: d20 19. Driver is raised as a zombie.

items.name: Tarrasque hood ornament
items.description: d20 20. −2 Max Speed; +2d6 piercing while ramming; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing; DC 17 Wis save to board your junk.

monsters.name: Blitzwing
monsters.notes: Adult blue dragon. FIRST Blitzwing revealed: he passes high overhead, no fight, press Victory. SECOND Blitzwing: he strafes the party with Lightning Breath (DC 19 Dex, 12d10 lightning, half on a save), then returns to D. Blitzwing's Scrapyard; press Victory once resolved.

monsters.name: Ghouls
monsters.notes: A gang of 1d4 + 2 ghouls dressed as junk racers descend on the party.

monsters.name: Black Pudding
monsters.notes: A random character accidentally steps into what looks like a puddle of oil, but it is actually a black pudding.
